-- System_v1 initial review schema
--
-- Purpose:
--   Supabase-backed review database for product-code matching,
--   Smartstore/Sellpia stock comparison, manual option decisions,
--   and local export workflow.
--
-- Safety:
--   - Stage/current source rows are append-only by convention.
--   - Manual review writes go only to decision tables.
--   - Seller upload and automatic reflection are outside this schema.
--   - Browser clients must use anon/publishable keys with RLS.

create extension if not exists pgcrypto with schema extensions
create schema if not exists stage
create schema if not exists review
create schema if not exists decision
create schema if not exists export

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Common batch registry
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

create table if not exists stage.import_batches (
  batch_id text primary key,
  source_channel text not null,
  source_file_name text,
  row_count integer,
  imported_by text,
  import_status text not null default 'draft',
  notes text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  completed_at timestamptz
)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Stage: Sellpia and channel current exports
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

create table if not exists stage.sellpia_stock_stage (
  id bigserial primary key,
  batch_id text not null references stage.import_batches(batch_id) on update cascade on delete restrict,
  source_row_no integer,
  sellpia_product_code text,
  sellpia_sku_code text,
  sellpia_product_name text,
  sellpia_option_name text,
  own_sku text,
  stock integer,
  available_stock integer,
  integrated_available_stock integer,
  safety_stock integer,
  raw_payload jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
)

create index if not exists ix_sellpia_stock_stage_batch
  on stage.sellpia_stock_stage(batch_id)

create index if not exists ix_sellpia_stock_stage_sku
  on stage.sellpia_stock_stage(sellpia_sku_code)

create table if not exists stage.smartstore_current_option_stage (
  id bigserial primary key,
  batch_id text not null references stage.import_batches(batch_id) on update cascade on delete restrict,
  source_row_no integer,
  smartstore_product_no text,
  smartstore_seller_product_code text,
  smartstore_product_name text,
  smartstore_option_group_name text,
  smartstore_option_code text,
  smartstore_option_name text,
  smartstore_option_price numeric,
  smartstore_option_stock integer,
  smartstore_option_use text,
  option_index integer,
  explode_warning text,
  raw_payload jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
)

create index if not exists ix_smartstore_current_batch
  on stage.smartstore_current_option_stage(batch_id)

create index if not exists ix_smartstore_current_product_no
  on stage.smartstore_current_option_stage(smartstore_product_no)

create index if not exists ix_smartstore_current_option_code
  on stage.smartstore_current_option_stage(smartstore_option_code)

create table if not exists stage.channel_option_stage (
  id bigserial primary key,
  batch_id text not null references stage.import_batches(batch_id) on update cascade on delete restrict,
  source_channel text not null,
  source_row_no text,
  channel_product_code text,
  channel_option_code text,
  channel_product_name text,
  channel_option_name text,
  channel_seller_code text,
  channel_stock integer,
  channel_status text,
  raw_payload jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
)

create index if not exists ix_channel_option_stage_channel_option
  on stage.channel_option_stage(source_channel, channel_option_code)

create index if not exists ix_channel_option_stage_seller_code
  on stage.channel_option_stage(source_channel, channel_seller_code)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Review queue: materialized rows for fast local HTML/Supabase UI
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

create table if not exists review.stock_compare_queue (
  queue_id bigserial primary key,
  batch_id text not null,
  source_channel text not null,
  source_row_no text,
  sellpia_product_code text,
  sellpia_sku_code text,
  sellpia_product_name text,
  sellpia_option_name text,
  sellpia_stock integer,
  sellpia_available_stock integer,
  sellpia_integrated_available_stock integer,
  sellpia_safety_stock integer,
  channel_product_code text,
  channel_option_code text,
  channel_product_name text,
  channel_option_name text,
  channel_stock integer,
  channel_status text,
  stock_diff integer,
  stock_compare_status text not null,
  auto_approval_tier text,
  auto_approval_score numeric,
  risk_reason text,
  recommended_action text,
  evidence_json jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
)

create index if not exists ix_stock_compare_queue_channel_status
  on review.stock_compare_queue(source_channel, stock_compare_status)

create index if not exists ix_stock_compare_queue_channel_option
  on review.stock_compare_queue(source_channel, channel_option_code)

create index if not exists ix_stock_compare_queue_sellpia_sku
  on review.stock_compare_queue(sellpia_sku_code)

create index if not exists ix_stock_compare_queue_auto_tier
  on review.stock_compare_queue(source_channel, auto_approval_tier)

create index if not exists ix_stock_compare_queue_abs_diff
  on review.stock_compare_queue(source_channel, abs(stock_diff))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Manual decisions: active row plus full audit trail
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

create table if not exists decision.option_match_decisions (
  decision_id bigserial primary key,
  source_channel text not null,
  decision_scope text not null default 'option_match',
  decision_status text not null,
  reviewer text not null,
  memo text,
  sellpia_product_code text,
  sellpia_sku_code text,
  sellpia_option_code text,
  channel_product_code text,
  channel_option_code text,
  channel_seller_code text,
  queue_id bigint,
  evidence_snapshot jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  is_current boolean not null default true,
  superseded_by bigint,
  superseded_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint ck_option_match_decision_scope
    check (decision_scope in ('option_match', 'disconnect_match')),
  constraint ck_option_match_decision_status
    check (decision_status in (
      'option_match_approved',
      'option_match_hold',
      'option_match_rejected',
      'option_match_unlinked',
      'option_match_cancelled'
    ))
)

create index if not exists ix_option_decisions_current_channel
  on decision.option_match_decisions(source_channel, decision_scope, decision_status)
  where is_current = true

create index if not exists ix_option_decisions_queue_id
  on decision.option_match_decisions(queue_id)
  where is_current = true

create unique index if not exists ux_option_decisions_current_key
  on decision.option_match_decisions (
    source_channel,
    decision_scope,
    coalesce(sellpia_sku_code, ''),
    coalesce(channel_product_code, ''),
    coalesce(channel_option_code, '')
  )
  where is_current = true

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Export jobs: local tool audit metadata, not seller upload logs
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

create table if not exists export.review_export_jobs (
  export_job_id bigserial primary key,
  source_channel text not null,
  export_type text not null,
  requested_by text,
  filter_json jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  row_count integer,
  output_file_name text,
  job_status text not null default 'created',
  notes text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  completed_at timestamptz
)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Read views for local HTML UI
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

create or replace view review.v_stock_compare_with_decision
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
  q.*,
  d.decision_id as manual_decision_id,
  d.decision_status as manual_decision_status,
  d.reviewer as manual_decision_reviewer,
  d.memo as manual_decision_memo,
  d.created_at as manual_decision_at
from review.stock_compare_queue q
left join decision.option_match_decisions d
  on d.is_current = true
 and d.decision_scope = 'option_match'
 and d.source_channel = q.source_channel
 and coalesce(d.sellpia_sku_code, '') = coalesce(q.sellpia_sku_code, '')
 and coalesce(d.channel_product_code, '') = coalesce(q.channel_product_code, '')
 and coalesce(d.channel_option_code, '') = coalesce(q.channel_option_code, '')
alter table stage.sellpia_stock_stage enable row level security
alter table stage.smartstore_current_option_stage enable row level security
alter table stage.channel_option_stage enable row level security
alter table review.stock_compare_queue enable row level security
alter table decision.option_match_decisions enable row level security
alter table export.review_export_jobs enable row level security

create policy "stage import batches readable"
  on stage.import_batches
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true)

create policy "sellpia stock stage readable"
  on stage.sellpia_stock_stage
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true)

create policy "smartstore current option stage readable"
  on stage.smartstore_current_option_stage
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true)

create policy "channel option stage readable"
  on stage.channel_option_stage
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true)

create policy "stock compare queue readable"
  on review.stock_compare_queue
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true)

create policy "option decisions readable"
  on decision.option_match_decisions
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true)

create policy "option decisions insertable by reviewer"
  on decision.option_match_decisions
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    reviewer is not null
    and btrim(reviewer) <> ''
    and decision_scope in ('option_match', 'disconnect_match')
    and decision_status in (
      'option_match_approved',
      'option_match_hold',
      'option_match_rejected',
      'option_match_unlinked',
      'option_match_cancelled'
    )
  )

create policy "export jobs readable"
  on export.review_export_jobs
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true)
